messages.subject: filters don't work
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

i have used R with the package „eurostat“.

If no filter is used, the query works.

if the filter geo=”AT” is used, the query results in an error (timeout).

Why does the filter-query not work?

> id<-"tsdec450"

> dat <- get_eurostat(id, time_format = "num")

Reading cache file C:\temp\RtmpWIJltP/eurostat/tsdec450_num_code_TF.rds

Table  tsdec450  read from cache file:  C:\temp\RtmpWIJltP/eurostat/tsdec450_num_code_TF.rds

> kable(head(dat))

|age   |unit   |sex |geo | time| values|

|:-----|:------|:---|:---|----:|------:|

|TOTAL |PC_ACT |T   |BE  | 1990|    6.6|

|TOTAL |PC_ACT |T   |DK  | 1990|    7.2|

|TOTAL |PC_ACT |T   |ES  | 1990|   15.5|

|TOTAL |PC_ACT |T   |FI  | 1990|    3.2|

|TOTAL |PC_ACT |T   |FR  | 1990|    7.9|

|TOTAL |PC_ACT |T   |IE  | 1990|   13.4|

> dat2 <-get_eurostat(id, time_format = "num", filters = list(geo = "AT"))

Fehler in curl::curl_fetch_memory(url, handle = handle) :

  Timeout was reached: Connection timed out after 10000 milliseconds

thanks for testing. I have testet the code on several days. Unfortunately, always the same error occurred.
I will inform my IT-Experts for help.

best regards
Egon
